integrity.publication_status: No new publication or outside authorship claimed.
integrity.verification: Exact Markov-generator/resolvent calculations and the positive-convolution proof establish the universal result; finite matrix calculations only provide diagnostics.

scientific_limitations: Two patches with independent exponential local extinction, identical recolonization rates in both directions, both initially occupied, and absorbing global extinction.
The theorem fixes the sum of local extinction hazards and recolonization rate, not arbitrary separate changes in patch conditions.
The full text of an especially relevant 2001 winking-patch management paper was unavailable for complete comparison; an equivalent historical result cannot be excluded.
No ordering of hazard rates, likelihood ratios, or extinction-time variances is proved.
title: Strict survival ordering under redistributed local extinction risk
